programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: The Society Murders
programme.desc: A building inspector arrives at Wentworth to inspect the rebuilding, but he's a fake. Once inside the jail, he knocks Colleen out, ties her up, and plants bombs around the prison. Meg rescues Colleen, but the women have been locked in the laundry with a bomb inside ticking away... Sharon is charged with murder as Alpha Centauri's true nature is exposed in the press, shattering her illusions. Helen decides to implicate herself to help her sister. Lizzie gets wind of Petra and Scott's relationship but vows to keep quiet. Petra tells Lizzie her father abused her, and was going to do the same to her sister, Emma, which is why she killed him. Later, when Emma visits Petra, we learn it was actually Emma who killed him. Lucy attacks Major the dog to stop him finding her drugs, and a furious Joan turfs her out. Ann forgives Wally. Lizzie gets a telegram from Foxy.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Harder They Fall
programme.desc: Mystery drama about a crime-fighting sleuth with a double life. Jane Doe investigates the death of a high-powered business mogul. She quickly discovers that the man's apparent drowning was staged to look like an accident.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: Blackout is a British TV drama series revolving around a corrupt council official who used to be an idealistic young man. Every new day brings him a new blackout because of alcohol, and sufferings to his family for the same reason. One day he gets his breath and realises he has become a murderer. He wants to tell his dark secret to his lawyer and goes to the court. There he becomes a witness of a shooting and covers an important witness with his own body. He becomes a local hero and people want to see him as the next mayor. He begins a dramatic quest for redemption.

programme.desc: After her husband's untimely demise, Marty marries Clark Davis, a widower, and raises his daughter Missie. However, Missie refuses to accept her as her stepmother, leaving her dejected.

programme.title: The Final Days of Planet Earth
programme.desc: When the tragic team of astronauts enlisted to excavate the moon returns to earth, it brings with it an alien-insect race that must harvest human bodies for survival. As their underground colony thrives, so does the fear that mankind's end has arrived.

programme.title: The Final Days of Planet Earth
programme.desc: Lloyd Walker is an anti-heroic archaeologist who, after stumbling upon an alien conspiracy, becomes enmeshed in an against-all-odds battle to save the human race. Part 2/2.

programme.desc: McBride takes on the defense of a friend's young co-worker who is accused of robbing and murdering a woman who gave him a ride. McBride and Phil discover that the victim had multiple identities--and multiple simultaneous husbands . . .

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: Daryl Dixon finds himself in France after his departure from The Commonwealth, raising the wrath of a broken but growing tyrannical movement in Paris and endangering a boy at the center of a benevolent religious movement.

programme.title: Prayers For Bobby
programme.desc: Emotional drama based on a true story. In 1970s America, a deeply devout mother finds her religious beliefs shaken when she learns that her son is gay. She urges her son to devote his time to the church in the hope that it will cure him of his 'sin', but the boy's increasing isolation leads to a tragic outcome. The woman is forced to question her faith and reassess her views.

programme.title: Icon
programme.desc: On the eve of the elections in Russia, there's an outbreak of a mysterious disease. The British are curious to find out what's going on, so they need to send someone. An official knows someone, Jason Monk, an American Agent who worked deep cover in Russia during the Cold War. He approaches Monk, who initially refuses till he tells Monk that he can help him settle some old scores and to see his daughter whom he left when he was pulled out. So Monk goes and makes contact with an old friend and a Russian policewoman. They learn that someone is trying to manipulate the election.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: DNA evidence and camera footage places a corrupt CEO as the prime suspect in the murder of a company whistle-blower, but Jane Doe believes the real killer may be a twin sibling.

programme.title: Merlin's Apprentice
programme.desc: Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

programme.title: Talking to Heaven
programme.desc: A man begins to have disturbing visions of dead people. All telling their story of how they died, and how their murderer is still out there. The detective investigating the murders looks to him for help in solving the case.

programme.title: Talking to Heaven
programme.desc: A medium and a detective join forces to uncover the identities of seven boys who have been murdered.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: Mystery drama featuring John Larroquette as a hard-nosed cop turned compassionate defence lawyer, who specialises in lost causes. His latest client is a failed actress who became a call girl out of desperation and is now accused of the brutal murder of a prominent Beverly Hills madam. McBride's investigations reveal that the victim was a blackmailer as well as a procurer, which considerably lengthens his list of suspects.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Prof. Lehman discovers in his Mexican observatory earth is about to be hit by asteroid 114 Kassandra, thrice the size of Mt. Everest, more than the meteor which ended the dinosaur age, preceded by a minor meteor shower. Alas on the road back he dies in a car crash. His assistant Imogen has a hard time getting his data home, where the military HQ is inaptly advised by Dr. Nate Chetwyn. LAPD detective Jack Crowe is set up for his wife's murder by his dirty ex-partner Calvin Stark, who kidnaps his daughter Jenny, determined to make him suffer. That includes Jack's dad, the sheriff in home town Taft, trying to keep order and organize help as the first debris hits cause damage. Life soon breaks down worldwide, in panic and looting after numerous hits. The military uses its rocket arsenal.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: The military naively thinks it's over after 3 quiet hours with a body count over 22,000 worldwide. Imogen continuous her perilous journey, slowly, and warns them Daniel's calculations were off too in mass, Kassandra broke and the largest part is left. The new debris shower even hits the HQ, all satellite communications go down. The only hope is observing from a space mission, by Morse over ground aerials. The US arsenal being nearly exhausted, the Chinese join, the Russians must be tricked. Vindictive Calvin Stark escapes and gets hold of Jenny, so Jack pursues them all his murderous way to Taft. There his dad the sheriff must control panic after the nuclear power station is hit, and help them face Calvin. Michael gets in even more danger because of ma's foolish instructions, dad and a fireman heroically come to the rescue.

programme.title: Jasper, Texas
programme.desc: In 1998, three white men in the small town of Jasper, Texas, chained a black man to the back of their pickup truck and dragged him to his death. This film relates that story and how it affected all of the residents of the town, both black and white.

programme.title: The Royal Scandal
programme.desc: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes - the world's greatest detective - faces a most alluring adversary... Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. After uncovering her true ambitions, Holmes draws the cunning songstress into a well-matched game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Cathy and Frank partner with a beautiful insurance investigator in the recovery of stolen art. Frank is smitten with her, even though it becomes more apparent she may be the mastermind behind the theft.

programme.title: Dinotopia 6: The Exit
programme.desc: After a plane crash, two opposing half-brothers find themselves on an amazing lost island where enlightened pacifist humans and intelligent talking dinosaurs have created a utopian medieval society. But imminent disaster approaches.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Championship game
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Championship game
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: In the wake of the largest volcanic eruption of the 1900s, an exploration by National Geographic led to the founding of Katmai National Park. From the volcanic ashes, the landscape regenerated, and a vibrant assembly of wildlife emerged. Witness the annual journey of brown bears, wolves, and salmon within the park.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: As the first national park founded to protect wildlife and ecological richness, the Everglades teems with life above and below water. This land of diversity boasts nine unique ecosystems, each shaped by the wet and dry seasons ebb and flow. Roseate spoonbills, black bears, alligators, bottlenose dolphins and panthers all thrive in the largest subtropical wilderness in North America.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Kalahari - Africa's Underground Desert
programme.desc: In the heart of southern Africa lies the Kalahari. It is an ancient desert made up of many different landscapes, with moods just as sweeping and dramatic, that is dependent on what lies beneath its surface: trillions of tons of sand and a secretive community of creatures who shape it and keep it alive. Without them, the Kalahari would slowly wither and die. But only the most ingenious, industrious and adaptable thrive here, forging clever alliances, exploiting fleeting opportunities, and pushing the limits of endurance in a world where every drop of energy — and every grain of sand — matters.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: Kalahari - Africa's Underground Desert
programme.desc: In the heart of southern Africa lies the Kalahari. It is an ancient desert made up of many different landscapes, with moods just as sweeping and dramatic, that is dependent on what lies beneath its surface: trillions of tons of sand and a secretive community of creatures who shape it and keep it alive. Without them, the Kalahari would slowly wither and die. But only the most ingenious, industrious and adaptable thrive here, forging clever alliances, exploiting fleeting opportunities, and pushing the limits of endurance in a world where every drop of energy — and every grain of sand — matters.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Winter. Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: The Emergence. Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move because they are locked into territories.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: The Awakening. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, Part 2 is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called 'boss crocs', are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Up Sheep's Creek. The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. The winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, Ben works around the clock.

programme.title: Python Invasion
programme.desc: Scientists and hunters team up to fight one of the biggest ecological threats to the Florida Everglades: the Burmese python. In the 1990s, pet pythons were released into the wild and have eaten their way through the food chain. Today, nobody knows how many there are, but estimates may be in the hundreds of thousands. We follow the scientists as they track, gather data, and try to understand better how Pythons reproduce and adapt in the Everglades. Ian Bartoszerk and his team at the Conservancy of Southwest Florida use male scout snakes to lead them to females with the potential to lay up to eighty eggs at a time. At the U.S.G.S., Amy Yackle and Mark Sandfoss work in tandem with wildlife biologists from the National Park Service and the University of Florida to battle female reproduction on another front — Alligator Alley.

programme.desc: Join us in our exploration of four of nature's deadliest animals: vipers, crocodiles, bears and sharks. Let's find out how they kill, what their abilities are and which one of them is the most deserving of the title - the ultimate predator.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. With the summer heat enticing the snakes into the city, it's the duo's job to safely catch the slithering creatures and release them safely back into the wild. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

programme.title: Valley of the Wolves
programme.desc: Imagine a place that holds everything you've ever wanted. High slopes and good timber for cover and den sites. Water. Your very own herds to hunt and all the wide open space you need for the chase. But others of your kind also want this place. They will challenge you for it. How far will you go to defend it? In the northeast corner of Yellowstone, the wolves of the Druid Peak Pack have long held sway, but their power is waning. The old leaders of the clan cannot stand against the challenge of the invading Slough Creek Pack. But the conquering wolves will find this no safe haven. Here, they will meet a strange and terrible fate. And though in exile, the Druids will rebuild their clan and gather the strength to return. In this beautiful but dangerous place, there is bounty and cruelty, loyalty and banishment, triumph and death. This is the story of the battle for the perfect valley and the high price wolves will pay for paradise.

Dingusių miestų atradimas su A. Linu
Išlikimas
programme.desc: Išgyvenimo instruktorius Hazel Audel leidžiasi į nesvetingą dykumą. Jis pasikliauja tik savo instinktais ir patirtimi, kurią įgyja svečiuodamasis pas vietinius gyventojus. programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Not your average bunch of teenagers, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles have been expertly trained by their anthropomorphic rat sensei, Splinter, in the art of ninjutsu. Criminals of New York beware, beneath the streets of this concrete metropolis, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael are waiting to put their training into practice, battling evil forces within the city and restoring peace. From petty thieves, to evil overlords, to aliens of an unfamiliar kind, New York is safe in the hands of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles!

programme.title: Sanjay and Craig
programme.desc: Does your neighbor have butt implants and a blueberry obsession? Can your best friend do ANYTHING without barfing? From their collection of fart jars to their shared love of chicken wings, Sanjay and Craig are more than a boy and his pet snake… they're family! Ready for the ride? Buckle up your fart baby and grab some napkins because Sanjay and Craig are about to douse you in awesome-sauce. NOICE! See you at the Frycade!

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: When Granny Tentacles goes out for a spa day, Patrick volunteers to watch over her house. In a failed attempt to follow Granny's instructions, Patrick makes his way into her home, then brings Squidina inside too. Between breaking Granny's furniture, tearing out her toilet, and letting a wild animal out of its cage, Patrick destroys the entire house, just as Granny returns home to witness it. // Without seeing him, the Star family obliviously smashes up Plankton, leading him to forget who he is. Meanwhile, Karen searches all over town for her missing husband.

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: Max & the Midknights fly to the village of Tresk to search for the missing Gnomes and discover a series of mysterious holes in the nearby forest. Before they can investigate, the kids are chased by two angry Ogres and run into Rovak, one of the kidnapped Gnomes from Tresk. Desperate to evade the Ogres, Rovak and the Midknights take shelter in a cottage owned by their friends, Bean and Barley. Rovak tells the Midknights how and why the Gnomes were kidnapped, but the story is interrupted when the two Ogres show up. As the Midknights and Rovak hide from the Ogres, Millie concocts a potion. But the kids are caught and the potion has an unexpected result: it turns the Midknights into gnomes. Meanwhile, Mumblin begins community service at Outpost 71, a mysterious factory run by penguins. Mumblin is relieved to learn that his friend Lenny is also serving community service, but when Mumblin learns that his sentence lasts ten thousand years, he decides to escape. Unfortunately, there's no way out. Or is there?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: House Fancy: Squidward is enraged when he sees the home of his rival, Squilliam featured on a TV show about fancy houses. Determined not to be outdone, Squidward arranges to have his own house on the program. But he quickly realizes that his house isn't exactly camera-ready and he's going to need a lot of help, even if it means letting SpongeBob redecorate. Krabby Road: When SpongeBob mistakenly thinks that Plankton is starting a band, Plankton decides to use this to advantage. He soon forms a rock band with SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward. Plankton's plan: get SpongeBob to write a song about the secret Krabby Patty formula!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donnie's trapped in a mad scientist's lab by the Monster Mutanimals Tokka, Rahzar, Scale Tail, Antrax and Wyrm who are after Wingnut's blood. Meanwhile, Leo, Mikey and Raph try to get pizza but the shop owner is furious: they've made a mess of the place too many times! But the Turtles have never been there before! They're confused until another Tokka wrecks the place in a huge fight before exploding into ooze...and then another Tokka arrives! In the lab, Donnie plans his escape but stumbles upon a video of Rahzar who explains the Monster Mutanimals are doomed unless they find the blood of a stable mutant... and they need Donatello's help! A real-life Rahzar lunges at Donnie, who fights him off until a whole pack of Monster Mutants shows up. The other three Turtles track their Tokka to the lab but are quickly captured. Donnie can only watch as his brothers are shoved into cages... and confronted by the creator of the Monster Mutanimals, the mad scientist Jordan Perry!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Boating Buddies: In an attempt to get away from SpongeBob, Squidward drives off in his boat as fast as he can. But he's stopped in his tracks when he's pulled over by a cop and is ordered to go to boating school. Now Squidward has to sit next to SpongeBob in class all day long and SpongeBob couldn't be happier! The Krabby Kronicle: When Mr. Krabs notices that the citizens of Bikini Bottom love buying tabloid newspapers, he decides to begin another business venture-his own tabloid! He recruits SpongeBob as his writer, but SpongeBob doesn't feel comfortable making up stories about other people because that would make him a liar. But Mr. Krabs assures him that making up stories for the paper isn't lying, it's using your imagination! SpongeBob discovers that making up stories about the people in Bikini Bottom is a lot of fun-but the people he's writing about don't think so.

Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Pinky Malinky
programme.desc: Pinky Malinky, a 12-year-old Middle School student, just so happens to be an anthropomorphic hot dog, who endeavors to climb up the social ladder with his two human friends, Babs Buttman and JJ Jameson.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: When the Midknights' ship is set off course, the team must survive treacherous new waters. Before Max can enact her plan, she is summoned to Wizard Court where Mumblin is on trial for his life. Max must help Mumblin prove that he is a good wizard and that he escaped the afterlife to help the Midknights defeat Fendra. If Max can't, Mumblin will be sent away for good. Max calls on the Midknights to testify on Mumblin's behalf. When those attempts fail, Max takes the stand. At first, Max's emotional testimony seems to win over the court, but her pleas for Mumblin's freedom backfire and Mumblin is ultimately found guilty. Luckily, Kevyn discovers a way to save Mumblin. Max must battle the Worms of Justice and if she wins, then Mumblin will be set free. Transported to a desert, Max battles giant worms. In the end, Max defeats the worms and Mumblin wins his trial. Unfortunately, the Midknights are sent back to their boat, which is headed straight for a massive waterfall!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Spongicus: Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket! In its place, he has built a Roman coliseum and announces there will be a gladiator show, which means togas, chariots, and ferocious lionfish. And on top of all that, it's free! No one in Bikini Bottom can resist, not even Mr. Krabs! Suction Cup Symphony: The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win. He immediately gets to work on his masterpiece, but when SpongeBob and Patrick keep disrupting Squidward's concentration, it looks like they might ruin his chance at musical stardom.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.desc: Johnny Depp e Al Pacino immensi interpreti di un avvincente gangster-movie. Un agente FBI conquista la fiducia di un anziano mafioso, nascondendo la sua identita' fino all'ultimo.

programme.title: Il paziente inglese
programme.desc: 9 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe all’intenso dramma con Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche e Willem Dafoe. Toscana, 2a guerra mondiale: un'infermiera accudisce un uomo che nasconde un tragico segreto.

programme.title: Il signore delle formiche

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: La stranezza
programme.desc: 4 David di Donatello al film di Roberto Andò con Toni Servillo affiancato dal duo comico Ficarra e Picone. Sicilia, 1920: l'incontro con due scapestrati becchini con la vocazione per il teatro ispira a Luigi Pirandello la stesura di "Sei personaggi in cerca d'autore".

programme.title: Il potere dei soldi
programme.desc: Robert Luketic dirige con maestria Gary Oldman e Harrison Ford in uno spy-thriller sullo spietato mondo dell'alta finanza a Wall Street. Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io

programme.desc: Dai produttori di "Scream", uno slasher horror che tinge di sangue una commedia romantica. Un sadico serial killer che massacra le coppie nel giorno di San Valentino sta per agire di nuovo a Seattle dove prende di mira due colleghi tra cui sta nascendo l'alchimia sentimentale.

programme.title: L'inferno di cristallo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al film precursore del genere catastrofico con Paul Newman e Steve McQueen. L'inaugurazione di un grattacielo a San Francisco rischia di trasformarsi in tragedia.

programme.title: Diabolik - Ginko all'attacco!
programme.desc: I Manetti Bros. dirigono Giacomo Gianniotti, Miriam Leone, Valerio Mastandrea e Monica Bellucci nel secondo film sul fumetto cult. Diabolik ed Eva Kant cadono nel piano di Ginko.

programme.title: Songbird
programme.desc: Prodotto da Michael Bay, un thriller che immagina un drammatico futuro. 2024: le continue mutazioni del Covid-19 hanno chiuso il mondo in un eterno lockdown. In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

programme.title: Psyco
programme.desc: Lezione di suspense e paura per la regia di Alfred Hitchcock, con Anthony Perkins, Vera Miles e Janet Leigh. Una donna in fuga arriva nel tetro motel gestito dall'inquietante Norman Bates.

programme.title: L'uomo di neve
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jo Nesbo, un thriller con Michael Fassbender, Rebecca Ferguson e Charlotte Gainsbourg, diretto dal regista de "La talpa". Durante l'inverno norvegese, il detective Harry Hole indaga sulla morte di una donna, uccisa nel corso della prima nevicata della stagione. Hole e' convinto che l'omicidio sia legato ad altri delitti avvenuti in passato. In ballo c'e' dunque un serial killer da fermare e l'unico modo per evitare che uccida ancora e' prevenirne le prossime mosse. "L'uomo di neve' e' il settimo romanzo dedicato al detective Harry Hole, il primo adattato per il cinema.

programme.title: Security
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original - di Peter Chelsom e con Marco D'Amore - sui torbidi segreti di una nota località turistica versiliese.

programme.title: Alex Cross - La memoria del killer
programme.desc: Thriller di Rob Cohen con Tyler Perry, Edward Burns e Jean Reno, dal romanzo di James Patterson. Il detective Alex Cross insegue il serial killer che ha assassinato sua moglie.

programme.title: Sympathy For The Devil
programme.desc: Un uomo è costretto a trasportare sulla sua auto un passeggero pericoloso. Con una pistola puntata alla tempia, l'uomo si trova coinvolto suo malgrado in un inseguimento dai risvolti imprevisti.

programme.title: Chi è senza peccato - The Dry
programme.desc: Eric Bana nel thriller tratto dal romanzo di Jane Harper. Non convinto dalla versione ufficiale dei fatti, un poliziotto torna nella sua citta' per indagare sul suicidio di un amico.

programme.title: Suburra
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Elio Germano, Claudio Amendola e Alessandro Borghi nel noir di Stefano Sollima. Tra corruzione dilagante e malavita si consuma la feroce lotta per il potere a Roma.

programme.title: Acid
programme.desc: L'angoscia per il cambiamento climatico in un fanta-thriller con Guillaume Canet e Laetitia Dosch. Durante un'anomala ondata di caldo, una perturbazione di pioggia acida e letale minaccia l'Europa, costringendo gli abitanti alla fuga verso una salvezza che appare impossibile.

programme.title: The Lodge
programme.desc: Riley Keough in un horror carico di misteri. Durante una bufera, due fratellini rimangono intrappolati in uno chalet con la fidanzata del padre, donna dall'ambiguo passato.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.sub-title: Le cose non dette e Poker Face
programme.desc: Analisi della pellicola di Gabriele Muccino sulla fragilità delle relazioni e della serie che reinterpreta il giallo-poliziesco.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult e Willem Dafoe nel remake di un classico dell'horror gotico, diretto da Robert Eggers. Un agente immobiliare viene inviato nei Carpazi, nello spettrale castello di un ambiguo conte, ossessionato dalla sposa del suo ospite.

programme.title: The Twin - L'altro volto del male
programme.desc: Teresa Palmer in un thriller dalle atmosfere suggestive. Dopo la morte del figlio, una coppia si trasferisce in Finlandia con il fratello gemello; ma quest'ultimo si comporta in modo strano.

programme.title: High Ground
programme.desc: Un misterioso nuovo detenuto finisce nella prigione di una città di frontiera. Lo sceriffo del posto si ritrova a dover affrontare l'ira di un brutale cartello della droga, che agisce senza pietà.

programme.title: Ida Red
programme.desc: Crime-thriller con Frank Grillo, Josh Hartnett e Melissa Leo. In prigione per omicidio, la matriarca di una famiglia del crimine tesse le fila della malavita dal carcere.

programme.title: State a casa
programme.desc: Roan Johnson dirige una dark comedy dal ritmo incalzante con Tommaso Ragno e Dario Aita. Roma: costretti dalla pandemia da Covid-19 a una convivenza forzata nell’appartamento che condividono, quattro ragazzi in difficoltà economica saranno travolti da una nefasta spirale di eventi.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins nei panni di Hannibal Lecter in un thriller con Edward Norton e Ralph Fiennes. Un detective consulta lo psichiatra criminale per catturare un killer detto Lupo Mannaro.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: George Clooney e Jennifer Lopez in un thriller di Steven Soderbergh, tratto da un romanzo di Elmore Leonard. Un rapinatore gentiluomo evade dal carcere e prende in ostaggio una poliziotta.

programme.title: Acid
programme.desc: L'angoscia per il cambiamento climatico in un fanta-thriller con Guillaume Canet e Laetitia Dosch. Durante un'anomala ondata di caldo, una perturbazione di pioggia acida e letale minaccia l'Europa, costringendo gli abitanti alla fuga verso una salvezza che appare impossibile.

programme.title: Flight Risk - Trappola ad alta quota
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.title: Dracula: L'amore perduto
programme.desc: Luc Besson reinventa Bram Stoker nel successo gotico-romantico con Caleb Landry Jones. Accecato dal dolore per la perdita della moglie, il principe Vlad diventa vampiro.

programme.title: Miss Sloane - Giochi di potere
programme.desc: John Madden dirige Jessica Chastain nei panni di un'impetuosa eroina della verita'. Una lobbista deve contrastare una proposta di legge sul controllo delle armi. Passera' al fronte opposto.

programme.title: The Watchers - Loro ti guardano
programme.desc: In un bosco nell'Irlanda occidentale, quattro persone si nascondono in un rifugio per proteggersi dalle mostruose creature che appaiono ogni notte. Mentre cercano una via d'uscita, devono fare i conti con l'inspiegabile mistero della foresta.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: M. Night Shyamalan dirige un formidabile James McAvoy. Tre ragazze vengono rapite da un maniaco con 23 diverse personalità, ma la più pericolosa è ancora nascosta nella sua psiche.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della storica saga horror apocalittica. Una ragazza scopre il legame tra un incubo ricorrente e una premonizione avuta da sua nonna che negli anni 60 salvò molte vite. Ma la Morte non dimentica e inizia a perseguitare i discendenti dei sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone dalla parte della legge in un appassionante thriller con Robert De Niro, Harvey Keitel e Ray Liotta. Lo sceriffo di una piccola cittadina del New Jersey, abitata soprattutto da poliziotti e per questo soprannominata 'Cop Land', non ha mai fatto carriera. Si limita a svolgere mansioni di poco conto all'ombra dei più agguerriti, e quotati, colleghi in divisa. Ma l'occasione per dimostrare il suo valore arriva, quando è costretto a indagare su una tragedia provocata proprio da uno sbirro e insabbiata dal resto dei poliziotti.

programme.title: Flight Risk - Trappola ad alta quota
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.title: America Latina
programme.desc: Elio Germano nello spiazzante thriller dei fratelli D'Innocenzo. Latina: un dentista vive in una villa con la sua famiglia. Un giorno, scendendo nelle cantine, incontra l'assurdo.

programme.title: Il codice da Vinci
programme.desc: Tom Hanks in un thriller di Ron Howard tratto dal bestseller di Dan Brown. Per scagionarsi da un'accusa di omicidio, un esperto di simbologia dovra' svelare uno sconcertante segreto.

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: Sophie Thatcher e Jack Quaid nel pazzesco fanta-thriller di Drew Hancock. Nella villa di un miliardario, inventore di una rivoluzionaria app per incontri, un gruppo di ragazzi viene travolto da una serie di imprevedibili eventi, fra insospettabili robot e un malloppo da rubare.

programme.title: Scomparsa
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried a caccia dell'assassino in un thriller psicologico. Tornata a casa dal lavoro Jill scopre che sua sorella, Molly, e' stata rapita. Come poteva accadere a lei un anno prima, quando riusci' a fuggire dal misterioso aggressore che adesso sembra tornato in azione. Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: L'uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Elisabeth Moss in un horror targato Blumhouse che rispolvera il personaggio creato da H.G. Wells. Cecilia e' sposata con Adrian Griffin, uno scienziato tanto brillante quanto psicopatico e maniaco del controllo. Una relazione tossica da cui la donna finalmente riesce a fuggire. Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

programme.title: La mia Africa
programme.desc: Sette Oscar all’intenso dramma di Sydney Pollack con Meryl Streep e Robert Redford, tratto dall’autobiografia di Karen Blixen. La scrittrice ripercorre gli anni passati in Kenya.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: Il bacio che aspettavo
programme.desc: Deluso da una donna e salvato dalle donne. Succede ad un aspirante scrittore che rompe con la fidanzata storica e si rifugia insieme al suo cuore infranto nel paese della nonna. Nuovi incontri gli faranno tornare la voglia di innamorarsi.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.title: Tumbledown
programme.desc: Rebecca Hall e Jason Sudeikis fra i paesaggi dei Maine in una commedia sul senso della perdita. Hannah, la giovane vedova dell'acclamato folk singer Hunter Miles, sta scrivendo la biografia del defunto marito nel tentativo di elaborare il lutto che la tormenta. Alla stesura collabora Andrew, uno scrittore e professore universitario che cerchera' di incrinare il guscio di rabbia e solitudine in cui Hannah si e' rinchiusa. Non solo per ultimare il libro, ma soprattutto per aiutarla a rifarsi una vita. Opera prima di Sean Mewshaw, assistente alla regia di Martin Scorsese in "Gangs of New York".

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Dall'omonima serie tv di grande successo, i sofisticati intrighi della famiglia Crawley. Gli aristocratici padroni di casa si mobilitano per l'imminente visita dei reali d’Inghilterra.

programme.title: Downton Abbey II - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Secondo film dedicato all'omonima serie. La famiglia Crawley si trasferisce in Costa Azzurra, mentre Lady Mary rimane nella tenuta di Downton Abbey, scelta come location per un film.

programme.title: Downton Abbey - Il gran finale
programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga tratta dall'omonimo period drama televisivo, gli aristocratici Crawley affrontano lo scandalo pubblico scoppiato per il divorzio di Lady Mary, candidata a prendere in mano le redini della famiglia.

programme.title: La mia Africa
programme.desc: Sette Oscar all’intenso dramma di Sydney Pollack con Meryl Streep e Robert Redford, tratto dall’autobiografia di Karen Blixen. La scrittrice ripercorre gli anni passati in Kenya.

programme.title: Corro da te
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Pierfrancesco Favino e Miriam Leone in una commedia brillante e dissacrante. Gianni e' un seduttore seriale, ma l'incontro con Chiara cambiera' tutto.

programme.desc: Francesco Arca e Denise Tantucci in una commedia romantica di Giulio Manfredonia. In aeroporto senza wi-fi, Tina si candida a un provino di danza grazie all'hotspot di un affascinante sconosciuto, Pietro. Tornata a Napoli, si accorge di un curioso segno del destino...

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.desc: Meryl Streep e Pierce Brosnan nel musical tratto dalle canzoni degli Abba. Per le sue nozze, Sophie invita tre ex amanti di sua madre, sperando finalmente di scoprire chi e' il padre.

programme.title: Il grande Gatsby
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Sweethearts
programme.desc: Divertente college movie tra amore e amicizia. Due matricole decidono di rompere con i rispettivi partner durante il Ringraziamento per non avere più vincoli. Ci riusciranno?

programme.title: Lei mi parla ancora
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Renato Pozzetto e un grande cast nel film Sky Original ispirato al romanzo di Giuseppe Sgarbi. Dopo la morte della moglie, un uomo ripercorre la storia d'amore di una vita.

programme.title: Corro da te
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Pierfrancesco Favino e Miriam Leone in una commedia brillante e dissacrante. Gianni e' un seduttore seriale, ma l'incontro con Chiara cambiera' tutto.

programme.title: 2 cuori e 2 capanne
programme.desc: Alessandra e Valerio non potrebbero essere più diversi. Le loro strade si incrociano per caso su un tram e passano una notte assieme. Il giorno dopo si rendono conto di lavorare nella stessa scuola.

programme.title: This Time Next Year - Cosa Fai A Capodanno?
programme.desc: Favola romantica con Sophie Cookson e Lucien Laviscount. Quinn, brillante imprenditore, e Minnie, iellata pasticcera, sono nati nella stessa clinica la notte di Capodanno del 1990. 30 anni dopo la loro vita non poteva essere più diversa, ma sono destinati a innamorarsi.

programme.title: Amore, cucina e curry
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Chocolat", commedia sull’arte culinaria con Helen Mirren. Preoccupata dalla concorrenza, una chef dichiara guerra a un bistrot indiano. Ma sottovaluta il talento del rivale.

programme.title: Intervista A Edoardo Leo - Ep. 476 - Intervista A Edoardo Leo
programme.desc: In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.desc: Michelle Pfeiffer e Paul Rudd in una commedia romantica. La quarantenne divorziata Rosie, sceneggiatrice di una serie tv, si infatua di un affascinante attore molto più giovane di lei.

programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. programme.title: Il tenente ottomano
programme.desc: L'amore in tempo di guerra in un dramma con Ben Kingsley e Josh Hartnett. Alla vigilia della Grande Guerra, un'infermiera lascia l'America per una missione medica nell'Impero turco.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di grigio
programme.desc: Eros e romanticismo per Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan, dal romanzo di E. L. James. Una studentessa viene sedotta da un uomo ricco e misterioso, che la coinvolge in un rapporto trasgressivo.

programme.title: Mamma mia! - Ci risiamo
programme.desc: Tornano Amanda Seyfried, Meryl Streep e Colin Firth nel sequel del musical scandito dalle canzoni degli Abba. Sull'isola greca di Kalokairi, Sophie e' alle prese con la ristrutturazione dell'hotel di famiglia e soffre per la mancanza di Sky, partito per uno stage di sei settimane negli Stati Uniti. Il ragazzo vorrebbe che lei lo raggiungesse, ma Sophie non vuole lasciare l'isola per non mancare di rispetto alla madre, Donna, scomparsa un anno prima. Alla vigilia dell'inaugurazione dell'albergo, tuttavia, un violento uragano si abbatte su Kalokairi.

programme.title: Terapia di coppia per amanti
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Pietro Sermonti e Sergio Rubini in una deliziosa commedia sui tormenti amorosi. Viviana e Modesto, entrambi sposati e con un figlio a testa, sono amanti clandestini da lungo tempo ma la loro relazione sta diventando sempre più complicata ai limiti dell’esasperazione. Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

programme.title: La quattordicesima domenica del tempo ordinario
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Lodo Guenzi, Edwige Fenech e Gabriele Lavia in una storia sul tempo perduto. L'incontro fra due ex amanti riporta alla luce sogni e disillusioni.

programme.title: Rifkin's Festival
programme.desc: Woody Allen dirige Gina Gershon e Louis Garrel in una commedia che racconta le vicissitudini di un ex insegnante di cinema, al seguito della moglie al Festival di San Sebastian.

programme.title: Am I Ok?
programme.desc: Dakota Johnson in una pellicola sulla scoperta della sessualità. Dopo una serie di appuntamenti fallimentari con uomini, Lucy realizza che dipende da ciò che vuole veramente.

programme.title: Che cosa aspettarsi quando si aspetta
programme.desc: Cameron Diaz, Jennifer Lopez e Anna Kendrick in una romantica commedia corale. Cinque coppie in dolce attesa si preparano alle gioie e alle preoccupazioni del loro futuro da genitori.

programme.desc: Oscar alla migliore canzone per l'opera prima di Bradley Cooper, anche protagonista insieme a Lady Gaga. Un esperto musicista aiuta una cantante a farsi strada nel mondo dello spettacolo.

programme.title: Questione di tempo

programme.desc: Mila Kunis e Susan Sarandon in uno scatenato sequel natalizio. A Natale tre amiche ricevono la visita delle rispettive mamme che porteranno ancora piu' scompiglio nelle loro vite.

programme.title: La donna esplosiva
programme.desc: Teen-comedy anni 80 con Kelly LeBrock e Robert Downey Jr. Impacciati con le ragazze, due adolescenti creano la donna ideale al computer e vengono coinvolti in una rocambolesca avventura.

programme.title: Happy Family
programme.desc: Commedia di Gabriele Salvatores con Margherita Buy, Fabio De Luigi e Diego Abatantuono. Le storie di due famiglie si intrecciano quando i rispettivi figli sedicenni decidono di sposarsi.

programme.title: Sapore di mare
programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. Amori e avventure in un periodo per molti indimenticabile. Sullo sfondo i successi musicali dei meravigliosi anni 60. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior attrice non protagonista a Virna Lisi.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Gatte da pelare
programme.desc: 26esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre la Fusco è a caccia della Rusic, Cioni e Govoni cercano di risolvere un caso da soli mettendo in difficoltà Pasquali.

programme.title: Scuola di polizia
programme.desc: Cult della commedia demenziale anni 80 con Steve Guttenberg e Kim Cattrall. La libera iscrizione richiama all'accademia di polizia una serie di improbabili e catastrofici personaggi.

programme.title: Papà scatenato
programme.desc: Due famiglie molto diverse a confronto per un mix di gag e risate in una commedia con Robert De Niro e il comico Sebastian Maniscalco.

programme.title: E' stato il figlio
programme.desc: Toni Servillo in una vicenda grottesca di Daniele Cipri'. Dopo la morte della figlia, una famiglia palermitana spende il risarcimento in una Mercedes. L'automobile segnera' la loro rovina.

programme.title: Ammore e malavita
programme.desc: Giampaolo Morelli, Claudia Gerini e Serena Rossi in una black comedy musicale dei Manetti Bros. Napoli: un boss si finge morto per cambiare vita, ma una testimone rovina i suoi piani.

programme.title: Qualunquemente
programme.desc: Antonio Albanese nei panni dello spassoso Cetto La Qualunque. Tornato in Italia dopo un periodo di latitanza, Cetto si candida a sindaco per difendere le sue proprieta' dalla... legalita'.

programme.title: Monty Python - Il senso della vita
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per l'ultimo capolavoro degli inimitabili Monty Python. La loro comicità visionaria esplode in una serie di sketch surreali e irriverenti.

programme.title: Modalita' aereo
programme.desc: Lillo e Paolo Ruffini in una commedia di Fausto Brizzi. Due inservienti dell'aeroporto si impossessano del cellulare di un ricco imprenditore e si vendicano della sua arroganza.

programme.title: Sapore di mare
programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. programme.title: Ma cosa ci dice il cervello
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Paola Cortellesi e un super cast nella commedia campione d'incassi. Giovanna mette le sue abilita' di agente segreto al servizio degli amici per vendicarli.

programme.title: Riunione di famiglia (Non sposate le mie figlie 3)
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga multietnica con Christian Clavier. Per il 40esimo anniversario di matrimonio di Claude e Marie le figlie organizzano una festa a sorpresa.

programme.title: Da grande
programme.desc: Renato Pozzetto in una delle sue commedia di maggior successo. Un bambino di otto anni esprime il desiderio di diventare adulto. Il miracolo si avvera e lui diventa un uomo di 40 anni.

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...
programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco
programme.desc: Colpo grosso a Las Vegas per George Clooney, Brad Pitt e un cast di stelle. Un ex galeotto raduna dieci complici per rapinare un caveau nella capitale del gioco d'azzardo.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Sasso carta forbici
programme.desc: 27esimo film ambientato a Pineta. A un passo dall’uscita della sua hit, Marchino scopre il cadavere della sua agente mentre i bimbi trovano un video hot di Pasquali.

programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si raccontano le migliori pellicole del leggendario Clint Eastwood disponibili da sabato 13 a venerdì 19 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: I Do
programme.desc: A young couple decides to get married, but aren't quite ready to deal with the trials that come with organizing a wedding. Between cold feet, family conflict, and exorbitant costs, the two end up flip-flopping between going through and canceling the wedding, much to the frustration of everyone around them.

programme.title: Block Z
programme.desc: A pre-med student and her friends encounter the death of a patient that exhibited symptoms of rabies. They are soon faced with an even bigger problem as their patient comes back from the dead and infects the people on campus, causing a lockdown and trapping the students inside.

programme.title: Sakaling Maging Tayo
programme.desc: Two college freshmen, Pol and Laya, accidentally meet during their last day of school in Baguio City. Laya is about to move back to Manila to escape from her failed romance, while Pol is about to spend a care-free night in a music festival. After witnessing Laya’s breakdown because of her recent heartbreak, Pol gets an idea to make her last night in Baguio fun and memorable.
